proposals.evidence: Turner asau explicitly supplies Old Marwari vo, Hindi wah, Punjabi/Lahnda o and Nepali u as remote demonstratives and third-person forms. These western and central survey paradigms are compared with that family, preserving ordinary b/v alternation and local gender/number inflection. Only third-person or distal-labelled responses are included; this/these responses and extra lexical material are excluded.
